Test Scenario: Verify successful login with valid credentials and session logout
Defect / Mistake Observed: TimeoutException: Timed out waiting for dashboard breadcrumb header after login.
Root Cause & Resolution: OrangeHRM's Vue.js SPA takes a moment to transition URL to /dashboard/index. Fixed by adding wait.until(urlContains('/dashboard')) and dynamic header locator in DashboardPage.

Test Scenario: Verify login rejection with invalid credentials
Defect / Mistake Observed: AssertionError: Test expected exact text 'Invalid credentials' but alert contained leading icon markup.
Root Cause & Resolution: Locator matched raw container. Fixed by targeting inner text element .oxd-alert-content-text with .contains('Invalid credentials').

Verify searching system users by username in Admin module
Defect / Mistake Observed: ElementClickInterceptedException: Admin menu item click intercepted by loading spinner overlay.
Root Cause & Resolution: Single-page app initial overlay prevented menu click. Added explicit wait for spinner disappearance before clicking Admin menu.

Test Scenario: Verify employee search in PIM employee list
Defect / Mistake Observed: NoSuchElementException: Employee table card element not found in DOM before search completed.
Root Cause & Resolution: AJAX search table loads asynchronously. Replaced implicit delay with explicit wait for .oxd-table-card visibility.
